sources.how: its LIS26 appearance page, re-checked: partner, Brazil, Politics, government & international trade
named in a research capture, as the curator mapped it
the mission page (EE-003616): approved companies by CNPJ and status at 28/8/2026: 188 rows, 105 confirmed, 26 awaiting, 33 waiting list, 24 withdrawn; no names
Sebrae, 30/9/2026: 100 startups selected nationally (40 with travel paid); about 300 expected with hubs and 12 state missions
about 200 companies: 99 in the summit programme, 90 from partner bodies, 50 from innovation ecosystems
led with Sebrae Startups; supported by Serpro, Embratur and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs
a 324 m2 space in the MEO Arena

note: Hand-written from the team CRM's record (crm@web-summit.dinis, 5 November 2026), re-checked 6 November 2026: Brazil's trade and investment promotion agency; with Sebrae Startups it runs the Brazilian mission and pavilion at Web Summit Lisbon 2026. Its mission page lists approved companies by CNPJ only, so a Brazilian startup is tied to it only where a CNPJ matches (Hablla).
